Quick tour
Here\'s a one-minute look at how WeaselPlex works. Press OK to start.
Home page rows
Left and Right move along a row. Up and Down change rows. Press OK to open a poster, or hold OK for options like adding it to your Watchlist.
Look up here
When you highlight a poster, its details appear at the top: name, episode, how long it is, and what it\'s about. You don\'t have to open it to peek.
The side menu
This is your main menu. Everything in WeaselPlex starts here. Press Left from a poster, or press Back on Home, to open it.
Your profile
This is the account you\'re signed in as. Select it to switch to another person. Everyone keeps their own watchlist and progress.
Looking for something specific? Open Search to type its name, or use the mic button to say it. It finds what\'s already here.
Your starting point. Select it from anywhere to jump back to Home. Select it while you\'re already on Home to update your rows with the newest content.
Your saved list of things to watch later. To add something, hold OK on its poster and choose Add to Watchlist.
Can\'t find a movie or show? Request it here, then check back to see whether it\'s been approved and added.
Browse by type
These icons open your content by category, top to bottom: Collections, Movies, TV Shows, Stand Up Comedy, and Sports.
Keep WeaselPlex up to date
When a new version is ready, this pops up as you open the app. Select Update and WeaselPlex updates itself. Always update when asked. To check yourself, go to Settings → About.
You\'re all set
Settings is where you change playback, subtitles, and how the app looks. You can replay this tour anytime from Settings → Help.
